title: Thai Crispy Duck Bites
description: Crispy fried duck bites in a tangy Thai sauce, served with fresh toast for dipping.
instructions: 1. Cut the duck breast into bite-sized pieces.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together the breadcrumbs and a pinch of salt.
3. Dredge the duck pieces in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to coat.
4. Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
5. Fry the duck pieces until crispy and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
6. Remove the duck from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
7. In a small bowl, mix together the orange marmalade and a squeeze of fresh lime juice.
8. Serve the crispy duck bites with the tangy marmalade sauce for dipping, accompanied by fresh toast slices.
